series_description: The remaining five syllabus chapters in one pack: Computer Fundamentals & Digital Logic, Software Engineering, Web Technologies, IT Tools & Emerging Technologies and Teaching Methodology — 238 previous-year questions, chapter-wise practice and the 200 most expected questions, weighted the way DSSSB weights these chapters. Short notes and a fast-revision sheet are in Courses → DSSSB TGT Computer Science.

tagline: Digital logic & architecture · SDLC & testing · HTML/CSS/JS/XML · MS Office, MIS, e-commerce, cyber law, AI/IoT/cloud · lesson planning, evaluation, child development
intro: In the 4 official DSSSB TGT Computer Science papers of 2023–24 these five chapters carried {n} questions — about 36 per paper, more than any other block. Fundamentals alone is 10 per paper and reaches into computer architecture, compilers, graphics and basic maths; IT Tools is really MIS, knowledge management, e-commerce, business/economics basics and cyber law; Teaching Methodology leans on child development and inclusive education. These notes are deliberately short: tables and one-liners that cover every asked area.
